title: Rare Fans
tagline: Rare Fans, is an NFT based, censorship resistant, web3 version of Patreon
description:
Rare Fans uses the combined power of polygon, lit, and web3 storage to make a censorship-resistant and decentralized version of Patreon.

Every creator deploys a version of our creator contract which is an ERC1155 using our CreatorRegistry and openzepplin clone. Then they can create Tiers with different supply and prices. Then they can create posts that get encrypted using lit protocol and only people who have specific tier NFTs will be able to decrypt that contents. The posts themselves are NFTs.
